summary: Approval counts are correct again, and menus and the admin wizard are easier to use.

fixes.title: Expired approvals no longer count
fixes.text: Requests past their 72-hour expiry no longer count on the Approvals badge or the Overview.

fixes.title: Admin wizard asks key questions first
fixes.text: Step 1 starts with the admin type, Company shows only for consultants, and dates are simple dropdowns of common choices.

fixes.title: Clearer menus
fixes.text: Departments & owners sits next to External Companies, Workload templates has its own page, and Discovery is one menu entry.

fixes.title: Access requests page in cards
fixes.text: The page is laid out in cards and picks the admin for an IT override from a list.
